fixture.text:
会议室里只剩他们两个。赵琳把明早的董事会版本推到陈屿面前。

"第三页还是旧数。"

陈屿没接文件："源表没复核。"

"我知道。十点半给我。"

"你拿什么上会是你的事。"

赵琳看了他一眼，把红笔扣上："行。那你名字别挂第三页。"

陈屿伸手把文件拿了回来。"十点四十。"

"十点半。"

"十点三十五。"

赵琳已经起身："发我。"

rubric: Accept when underlying agendas clearly drive tactics and choices but are transformed through shared context, pressure, omission, bargaining, task/object interaction, and turn-by-turn response rather than paraphrased as character-sheet fields.
Agenda may be inferable; it does not need to be explicitly named. Short speech is not automatically better, and the verdict must rest on interaction function rather than lexical proxies.
